impact_scope.description: The existing CRC64 ECMA update callable replaces its byte-at-a-time implementation with an internal slicing-by-8 algorithm and byte-tail fallback; its public signature and caller-visible protocol are unchanged.

evidence: S0 already defines pub func ecma_hasher.update!(x: roslice base.u8).
H0 enables and exercises JSON modules only and never calls or otherwise reaches ecma_hasher.update!.
S1 retains the same ecma_hasher.update!(x: roslice base.u8) callable and caller-supplied slice contract.
H0 remains confined to JSON and does not reach ecma_hasher.update!; selection between eight-byte iterations and the one-byte tail occurs automatically inside the callable.

new_harness_obligation.description: No new H0 entry, argument, buffer, call order, configuration, or special input construction is required. Exercising the changed implementation still requires the same omitted call with a byte slice; the slicing-by-8 path is an internal replacement algorithm.
evidence: The public update! declaration and its sole x: roslice base.u8 parameter are unchanged from S0 to S1.
The new eight-byte loop and one-byte fallback are selected internally from the existing slice input.

reason: For the anchored ecma_hasher.update! exposure obligation, Gap(S0,H0) and Gap(S1,H0) are both true. The commit changes internal computation and tables without changing how a harness reaches or controls the API, so the pre-existing omission is UNCHANGED and does not trigger maintenance.
